lede: The clearest signal on the web today is Nvidia's board reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive, a story that surfaced on five feeds at once and topped Hacker News with 2,396 points and more than 3,300 comments. On Polymarket, a contract on a new Nvidia CEO being named by year end drew 2.4 million dollars in 24-hour volume and sat near 100 percent. The single most-read article on Wikipedia was not Nvidia, though, but Ramayana: Part 1, holding first place for a fifteenth straight day.

throughlines.title: Avengers: Doomsday
throughlines.gist: The final trailer for Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday, in theaters December 18, drew more than 33 million views on YouTube in a day and pushed the film onto Wikipedia's most-read list.

throughlines.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
throughlines.gist: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive on day eleven of the story, a reversal carried at once by Hacker News, Wikipedia, Lemmy, Bluesky and GDELT, where the wire reported Asian stocks rallying on his return.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
throughlines.gist: Grand Theft Auto VI, out since November 19, holds second on Wikipedia with 266,240 views and its soundtrack is climbing YouTube on the game's first weekend on sale.
throughlines.why: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI launched on November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, and this weekend is its first on sale.
